profile_text: Operating a senior living park in Düsseldorf, this care services provider offers residential and care solutions for elderly individuals, employing 70 people in 2024. Despite a 14.6% decline in growth since the baseline, the company has been categorized as a Gazelle, indicating its potential for rapid expansion. As a key player in the human health and social work activities sector, it is well-positioned to address the growing demand for elderly care services in the region.
